purpose: Declared product and research decisions that ASA cannot make on current data, each tied to recorded evidence. OI-07 quantifies them against session captures. Nothing here authorizes procurement.

decisions.decision: Weight opportunity ordering by forward outcomes, or claim one strategy outperforms another
decisions.blocked_by: Forward-outcome sample below the OI-06 guard (30 observed outcomes with modeled P&L per strategy). The corpus is user-tracked only; auto-enrollment needs a separate Architect decision.
decisions.unlock: Time and corpus growth, not purchase. Paid historical option chains would give backtest evidence, a different evidence class that does not replace ASA's own forward outcomes.

decisions.decision: Evaluate B002 (adjusted-close stock benchmark) at all
decisions.blocked_by: Adjusted-close history entitlement (Alpha Vantage). B002 is typed unknown every session.
decisions.unlock: A source of split-and-dividend-adjusted or total-return history with explicit semantics

decisions.decision: Apply Skew Momentum's historical skew-stretch gate before 40 sessions have accumulated
decisions.blocked_by: No configured provider supplies prior option chains, so historical skew accumulates one session at a time and nothing is backfilled.
decisions.unlock: Time (prospective accumulation), or historical option chains/IV history. That capability is absent from the data-adequacy-v1 matrix and would need a matrix amendment.

decisions.decision: Add IV-Rank-gated option strategies (e.g. tastylive 45-DTE credit spread, Option Alpha CORE put credit spread)
decisions.blocked_by: No producer for historical IV / IV Rank; such strategies would be permanently UNKNOWN
decisions.unlock: Historical implied-volatility series per underlying, or time to accumulate IV prospectively

decisions.decision: Add SPX index-option strategies (e.g. Cboe CNDR) without an SPY substitution
decisions.blocked_by: Index-underlying, root and settlement identity are not modelled, and the T-bill rate is not acquired. The missing modelling is ASA-owned work, and it needs an ARCH-005 amendment.
decisions.unlock: An Architect decision and index modelling (ASA work), plus a rate source

decisions.decision: Evaluate earnings-driven opportunities on symbols without a confirmed earnings date
decisions.blocked_by: Provider earnings coverage. Some events are genuinely unannounced, and no source can resolve those.
decisions.unlock: A confirmed earnings calendar with announcement status
unlock_gaps: confirmed earnings calendar with announcement status and effective timestamps

decisions.decision: Evaluate option strategies on symbols whose chain lacks IV, Greeks, or a usable quote
decisions.unlock: Complete option expiration, contract, quote, Greek, and IV evidence
unlock_gaps: complete option expiration, contract, quote, Greek, and implied-volatility evidence

decisions.decision: Run TGSM / S001 research on qualified long history
decisions.blocked_by: No qualified total-return, Treasury total-return, or point-in-time reference data
unlock_gaps: authoritative point-in-time sector membership and historical exchange calendar
